thread:
Elena: Heads-up before the weekly KPI review 10: our webinar routing cohort shows a weird drop in last-click attribution for launch posts vs benchmark.
Rohit: saw that on the draft deck. Overall sessions steady, conversions down ~42% on the post-click metric.
Dana: any chance GA4 sampling kicked in for that segment? We pushed more targeting yesterday.
analytics-bot: GA4-note: property 'redwood-marketing' reported sampling >1% for query window 2026-03-18..2026-03-20.
Maya: also double-check the AB test rollout for the messaging variation B  we toggled at 09:00 PDT 3/19. Could be variant mismatch in attribution tags.
Elena: good call. Rohit can you pull a raw click -> lead_id join so we can verify client-side tags vs server events?
Rohit: on it. Quick SQL: ```sql
SELECT minute, count(distinct lead_id) as leads, sum(case when source='post' then 1 else 0 end) as post_clicks
FROM events_raw
WHERE campaign = 'launch_posts' AND ts >= '2026-03-19'::date AND ts < '2026-03-20'::date
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute LIMIT 60;
```
Rohit: summary: leads 312 (baseline 540), post_clicks 820 (baseline 900) — click volume not enough to explain lead drop.
Dana: that points at a funnel drop (form->thankyou) or third-party widget. We rolled a new form handler last week.
Maya: ops-bot, any errors flagged on form-handler svc 3/19?
ops-bot: incident-check: form-handler returned 502 spikes between 15:12-15:36 UTC on 2026-03-19. Error-rate: 7.2%.
Elena: that's our window. ROI numbers in the deck will be misleading if we don't annotate. Action plan: 1) Rohit to run backfill for 3/19 14:00-16:00 to see if ingestion lag dropped leads. 2) Dana to compare variant B vs A conversion rates on raw events (not GA). 3) Maya to add a footnote and reserve a slide in the weekly for 'attribution caveats'.
Rohit: queued a backfill job (id: backfill-1791234701). ETA ~30m.
Dana: quick run now on variant split shows A -> lead_rate 2.1% vs B -> 0.8% during the window. Variant B correlated with a client-side script we shipped.
Maya: copy. If the backfill recovers 3/19 leads then it's ingestion; if not, we call it messaging/regression and pause variant B.
Elena: for the benchmark narrative: we'll present baseline uplift vs last 3 launches but add a slide with the anomaly and remediation steps. Keep language short.
Rohit: backfill finished: reconciliation +18 leads for the window, still short of baseline.
Dana: so partial ingestion + variant regression. Recommend: rollback variant B for next 24h, rerun small audience, and keep monitoring.
Maya: agree. Dana, roll it back and post the rollback note in #launch-posts. Elena, I'll annotate the deck and add a tracker row for "3/19 form-handler + variant B".
ops-bot: rollback action: variant B rolled back at 2026-03-20T16:40:12Z by Dana.
analytics-bot: KPI-deck note added: "3/19 conversion anomaly due to partial ingestion + messaging variant B; backfill + rollback executed."
